description: This file defines the static class GlobalFontSettings in the PdfSharp.Fonts namespace, responsible for managing font-related settings such as font resolver configuration, fallback font resolver, font encoding, and platform-specific font usage under Windows and WSL2. It includes functionality to set, reset, and restrict modifications to font settings, as well as internal storage of these configurations.

classes.name: GlobalFontSettings
classes.description: Provides static methods and properties to manage font configuration settings, including resolvers, encoding, and platform-specific font usage adjustments.

methods.name: SetFontResolver
methods.description: Internal method to assign a font resolver, with checks to prevent changes after font sources are used.

methods.name: ResetAll
methods.description: Resets all font resolver settings and internal caches, typically used for testing.

methods.name: ResetFontManagement
methods.description: Shortcut method to reset font management settings.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Internal method to reset font resolvers and platform usage flags.
